description: A day's tokens, from the turns that ended in it.

day.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD, the host's time.

tokens.description: Every token of them: input, cache writes and reads, output, and input_with_cache.

input.description: Input tokens sent that weren't read from a cache or written to one.

cache_write.description: Input tokens written to a cache.

cache_read.description: Input tokens read from a cache.

input_with_cache.description: Input tokens of turns kept before their tokens were told apart, cache reads and writes among them.
